measures.id: Chillicothe City Proposed Municipal Income Tax
measures.title: Chillicothe City Proposed Municipal Income Tax (0.2% for streets)
measures.summary: Asks whether to pass a City of Chillicothe ordinance levying a 0.2 percent tax on income. The money would be used only for street paving, repairs and improvements.
measures.yesMeans: The 0.2 percent city income tax for street paving, repairs and improvements would be passed.
measures.noMeans: The 0.2 percent city income tax for streets would not be passed.
